info.title: UNHCR proGres v4 interoperability API (DTP)
info.description: proGres v4 is UNHCR's refugee registration and case management system. It has no public REST API: partner systems reach it through UNHCR's Data Transfer Platform (DTP), an Azure API Management gateway that fronts proGres and is reachable only with a UNHCR-issued subscription key and a client certificate. The surface is message-oriented rather than resourceful — one POST endpoint per interoperability message type, with the same type repeated in the body's `request_type` field. This document is reverse-engineered from the OpenFn progres adaptor and from OpenFn's UNICEF/UNHCR reference integration (OpenFn/primero-progres), which is the only public source of DTP endpoint paths and payloads; UNHCR publishes no specification. The adaptor exposes a single operation, `postData({ url, body, headers, agentOptions })`, a mutual-TLS POST to whichever DTP URL the credential supplies. The two messages proGres sends back out (PrimeroOutgoingReferral and PrimeroIncomingReferralDecision) are delivered to a partner inbox rather than served here, so they are modelled as component schemas with no path.

servers.description: UNHCR DTP gateway (Azure API Management). Both segments are issued by UNHCR per integration; the values below are the UAT endpoint used by OpenFn's reference integration.

deployment.description: DTP API path for this integration and environment.

tags.name: referrals
tags.description: Interagency referral messages exchanged with proGres v4 through DTP.

post.summary: Send an interagency referral into proGres v4
post.description: Creates a proGres intervention from a partner system's referral. Send one message per referred service. The body's `request_type` must be `ReceiveIncomingReferral`. proGres answers asynchronously: its review decision arrives later as a `PrimeroIncomingReferralDecision` message posted to the partner's inbox.

200.description: The message was accepted and queued for proGres.

401.description: Missing or invalid subscription key, or the client certificate was rejected.

403.description: The subscription is not authorised for this operation.

500.description: DTP could not hand the message to proGres.

post.summary: Report the partner system's decision on a referral proGres sent out
post.description: Closes the loop on a `PrimeroOutgoingReferral`: tells proGres whether the partner caseworker accepted or rejected the intervention, and why.

200.description: The message was accepted and queued for proGres.

401.description: Missing or invalid subscription key, or the client certificate was rejected.

403.description: The subscription is not authorised for this operation.

500.description: DTP could not hand the message to proGres.

post.summary: Acknowledge delivery of an intervention, or report that it failed
post.description: Delivery notification for one intervention. A success notice carries `status: "Pending Acknowledgement"`; a failure carries `status: "Delivery Fail"`, `request_type: "Feedback"` and a `closure_reason`. In the OpenFn reference integration both are posted to the single DTP URL held in the credential's `url` field, so the path segment below is the request type's own name rather than an independently confirmed route.

200.description: The message was accepted and queued for proGres.

401.description: Missing or invalid subscription key, or the client certificate was rejected.

403.description: The subscription is not authorised for this operation.

500.description: DTP could not hand the message to proGres.

subscriptionKey.name: Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key
subscriptionKey.description: UNHCR-issued Azure API Management subscription key. DTP additionally requires mutual TLS: the client must present a UNHCR-issued certificate and private key on the connection (the OpenFn adaptor passes them as `agentOptions.cert` and `agentOptions.key`). OpenAPI 3.0 cannot express that transport requirement, so it is stated here rather than as a security scheme.

InboundReferral.description: An interagency referral sent from a partner case-management system into proGres v4. One message per service. DTP routes on `request_type`, matches the individual on `unhcr_individual_no` / `unhcr_id_no`, and raises a proGres intervention.

request_type.description: Message type. DTP routes on this value.

id.description: Referral id supplied by the sender; unique per case/service pair.

service_implementing_agency.description: Agency that will deliver the service.

owned_by_agency_id.description: Agency that owns the referring case.

service_type.description: proGres service label, e.g. `Child Protection Service`, `Legal Assistance Service`.

service_response_day_time.description: When the service is expected to be delivered.

unhcr_individual_no.description: UNHCR individual number of the person referred.

OutgoingReferralDecision.description: The referring system's decision on a referral proGres sent out to it: the partner caseworker accepted or rejected the intervention.

case_id.description: Identifier of the case in the referring system.

primero_user.description: Username of the caseworker the decision belongs to.

progres_interventionnumber.description: proGres intervention number the message relates to, e.g. `NAI-20-PRTITV-0000006`.

closure_reason.description: Free text explaining a rejection or a delivery failure.

ReferralFeedback.description: A delivery acknowledgement or failure notice for one intervention, posted back to DTP after the partner system has (or has not) created the record.

request_type.description: Omitted on success notices in some deployments.

case_id.description: Identifier of the case in the referring system.

primero_user.description: Username of the caseworker the decision belongs to.

progres_interventionnumber.description: proGres intervention number the message relates to, e.g. `NAI-20-PRTITV-0000006`.

closure_reason.description: Free text explaining a rejection or a delivery failure.

example.closure_reason: Intervention referral is missing fields required for sending. Please include missing fields and re-send the request.

DtpAcknowledgement.description: What the DTP gateway returns on a successful submission. DTP answers 2xx once the message is queued; the body is not documented by UNHCR and the OpenFn jobs ignore it, so no fields are asserted here.

DtpError.description: Azure API Management error body returned when the gateway rejects a request.

ProgresIntervention.description: One proGres v4 intervention, as DTP emits it. Keys are proGres/Dataverse attribute names, dotted where the value is drawn from a related entity.

progres_businessowner.description: GUID of the owning business unit.

individuals.progres_registrationgroupid.description: Dataverse lookup to the registration (case) group.

interventiontype.progres_description.description: Service label of the intervention type.

ProgresOutgoingReferral.description: Inbound message: a referral proGres v4 is sending out to a partner system. DTP posts this to the partner's inbox (an OpenFn webhook URL); it is not an endpoint this API serves.

__query_params.description: Query string of the inbox request, added by OpenFn.

ProgresReferralDecision.description: A proGres caseworker's review decision on a referral the partner system sent in.

progres_orgreferralid.description: The `id` the partner system sent on the original referral.

progres_reviewdecision.description: proGres option-set code for the decision.

ProgresIncomingReferralDecision.description: Inbound message: proGres v4's decision on a referral the partner system sent in. DTP posts this to the partner's inbox; it is not an endpoint this API serves.
